bundle.shortDescription: Live context and spend gauges for AI coding sessions.
bundle.longDescription: Greedout reads AI coding session transcripts from disk and shows the most recently active sessions as always-on-top gauges: context fill against the model's window, estimated spend, and a per-session history graph. Claude Code is the harness supported today; the design is harness-agnostic.
